title: Chevalley's theorem: images of constructible sets
statement: Let $f:X\to Y$ be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme] which is quasi-compact [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions] and locally of finite presentation [def-sbc-locally-finite-presentation], and assume that $Y$ is quasi-compact and quasi-separated [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions]. Then for every constructible subset $C\subseteq X$ [def-weil-constructible-subset] the image $f(C)$ is a constructible subset of $Y$. In particular ($C=X$, which is constructible) the image $f(X)$ is constructible in $Y$ (Stacks Morphisms, Lemma 054J).
